common.name: Name
common.translationNotice: This document is a translation of the Hebrew original, which is the legally binding version. In case of any discrepancy, the Hebrew version prevails.
common.therefore: Now, therefore, the parties declare, stipulate and agree as follows:
common.witness: In witness whereof the parties have signed:
common.noPayments: No payments have been made yet.
common.general1: This agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes any prior representation, promise or agreement, oral or written. Any change to this agreement must be made in writing and signed by both parties.
common.general2: No waiver, indulgence or extension by either party shall be deemed a waiver of its rights unless made in writing.
common.general3: The Hebrew version of this document is the binding version. A translation into another language is provided for convenience only.
common.general4: The parties' addresses for the purposes of this document are as set out herein. The competent courts in the area of the place of business of {{party}} shall have local jurisdiction.

title.CAR_AND_NUMBER: Taxi Vehicle and Taxi Licence Lease Agreement

lease.recital1: Whereas the Lessor holds the rights in taxi operating licence No. {{license}} (hereinafter: "the Licence");
lease.recital2: Whereas the Lessor owns the taxi vehicle described in this agreement (hereinafter: "the Vehicle");
lease.recital3: Whereas the Lessee declares that he holds a valid driving licence of the grade required to carry passengers by taxi, a valid taxi driver permit and a valid medical certificate, and that there is no legal impediment to his entering into this agreement;
lease.recital4: And whereas the parties wish to set out the terms of the lease as follows;

object.NUMBER_ONLY: The Lessor leases to the Lessee the right to use taxi operating licence No. {{license}}. The Licence will be registered on the Lessee's taxi vehicle described below, and the Lessee shall sign every document required to register the Licence on his vehicle and to detach it at the end of the lease.
object.CAR_AND_NUMBER: The Lessor leases to the Lessee the taxi vehicle described below together with taxi operating licence No. {{license}} registered on it.

lease.driverCar: Lessee's vehicle on which the Licence is registered
lease.driverCarMissing: The details of the Lessee's vehicle will be attached to this agreement before the Licence is registered on it.
lease.objectCondition: The Lessee confirms that he has inspected the Vehicle and found it in good order and fit for the purpose of the lease. The condition of the Vehicle at handover will be recorded in a signed handover report, which forms an integral part of this agreement.
lease.term: The lease term begins on {{start}} and ends on {{end}} (inclusive), unless terminated earlier in accordance with this agreement. Any extension requires written agreement.
lease.rent: The Lessee shall pay the Lessor a monthly rent of {{rent}} {{vat}}.
lease.rentPlusVat: plus VAT as required by law ({{rate}}%)
lease.rentPayment: Rent is payable in advance by day {{day}} of each calendar month. For the first and last months of the lease term, rent is prorated by the actual number of lease days in that month.
lease.rentLate: A delay of more than 14 days in paying rent constitutes a material breach of this agreement. Any amount not paid on time bears linkage differentials and interest as provided by law until actually paid.
lease.deposit: To secure the performance of his obligations, the Lessee shall give the Lessor, upon signing this agreement, a deposit of {{amount}} (form of deposit: {{kind}}). A written confirmation will be issued for the deposit.
lease.depositOffset: The Lessor may set off against the deposit any amount the Lessee owes under this agreement, including rent, fines, damages and agreed compensation, after giving the Lessee written notice.
lease.depositReturn: The balance of the deposit will be returned to the Lessee within 30 days after the end of the lease term and the return of {{object}} to the Lessor, less any amounts the Lessee owes. The deposit bears no interest or linkage, and a written confirmation will be issued upon its return.
lease.noDeposit: No deposit is required under this agreement.
lease.costsIntro: The costs listed below shall be borne by the party indicated next to each:

costs.insurance: Compulsory and comprehensive or third-party insurance, including cover for carrying passengers for hire
costs.test: Annual roadworthiness test and vehicle licence fee
costs.fines: Traffic and parking tickets, road tolls and fines

lease.costsOther: Fuel, cleaning and day-to-day operating costs are borne by the Lessee. A cost borne by the Lessee that was paid by the Lessor will be charged to the Lessee's account and paid by him within 7 days of demand.
lease.fines1: The Lessee is personally and solely responsible for every offence committed and for every ticket, fine, toll or other charge imposed for the use of {{object}} during the lease term.
lease.fines2: The Lessee agrees that the Lessor will transfer to the Lessee's name any ticket received for the lease period, and undertakes to sign every document required for this purpose and to provide his details to the competent authority. The Lessee is aware that a ticket must be transferred within 90 days of its receipt.
lease.fines3: A ticket paid by the Lessor for any reason will be charged to the Lessee's account together with the handling costs.
lease.useTitle: Use of the Vehicle and the Licence
lease.use1: The Lessee shall use {{object}} only to carry passengers by taxi, in accordance with every law, including the Traffic Ordinance and its regulations and the instructions of the Ministry of Transport.
lease.use2: The Lessee shall not transfer, sublease or allow any other person to use {{object}} without the Lessor's prior written consent.
lease.use3: The taxi meter shall be operated on every trip and remain sealed as required by law. The Licence may be moved from one vehicle to another only by means of the prescribed form and with the consent of the Licence holder.
lease.use4: The Lessee shall notify the Lessor of any accident, damage, theft or approach by a competent authority within 24 hours, and shall keep his driving licence, taxi driver permit and medical certificate valid throughout the lease term.
lease.independent1: The Lessee acts as an independent service provider, on his own account and at his own responsibility. Nothing in this agreement or its performance creates an employer-employee relationship between the Lessor and the Lessee or anyone on his behalf.
lease.independent2: Income from carrying passengers belongs to the Lessee, who alone is responsible for reporting and paying income tax, VAT, national insurance contributions and any other mandatory payment in respect of his activity.
lease.independent3: The rent was set on the basis that there is no employer-employee relationship between the parties. Should a competent tribunal decide otherwise, the lease consideration shall be deemed to reflect all rights to which the Lessee would have been entitled.
lease.end1: Either party may terminate this agreement before the end of the lease term by giving 30 days' prior written notice.
lease.end2: If the Lessee terminates this agreement before the end of the lease term other than because of a breach by the Lessor, he shall pay the Lessor agreed compensation equal to the monthly rent multiplied by {{months}} ({{amount}}), which the parties estimate in advance as reasonable compensation for the Lessor's loss.
lease.end2None: Early termination by the Lessee, with notice as above, does not give rise to agreed compensation.
lease.end3: The Lessor may cancel this agreement immediately by written notice if the Lessee is more than 14 days late in payment, loses his driving licence or taxi driver permit, uses {{object}} in breach of the law or this agreement, or commits any other material breach of this agreement.
lease.returnTitle: Return at the end of the lease

return.NUMBER_ONLY: At the end of the lease the Lessee shall sign every document required to detach the Licence from his vehicle and to move it to another vehicle of the Lessor's choice, and shall return to the Lessor the taxi meter and operating equipment, insofar as they belong to the Lessor.
return.CAR_AND_NUMBER: At the end of the lease the Lessee shall return the Vehicle to the Lessor in the condition in which it was received, save for reasonable wear and tear from normal use, together with the keys and documents. The condition of the Vehicle will be recorded in a signed return report, and damage beyond reasonable wear and tear will be charged to the Lessee's account.

checklist.introHandover: This report records the condition of the vehicle when handed over to the Lessee under lease agreement No. {{contractNo}}.
checklist.introReturn: This report records the condition of the vehicle when returned to the Lessor under lease agreement No. {{contractNo}}.

items.photosTaken: Photos of the vehicle taken from all sides
items.docsInCar: Vehicle licence and insurance certificate in the vehicle
items.meterSealed: Taxi meter in order and sealed
items.newDamages: New damage found compared with the handover

checklist.notFilled: This report has not yet been completed in the system; fill in the details by hand at the inspection.
checklist.declarationHandover: The Lessee confirms that he has inspected the vehicle and received it in the condition described in this report, and that the vehicle is fit for the purpose of the lease.
checklist.declarationReturn: The parties confirm that the vehicle was returned in the condition described in this report. Damage beyond reasonable wear and tear will be charged in accordance with the lease agreement.

receipt.notTaxInvoice: This confirmation is not a tax invoice or receipt (אינו מהווה חשבונית מס/קבלה).
receipt.depositIn: We confirm that we have received from the Lessee a deposit of {{amount}} as security for the performance of his obligations under lease agreement No. {{contractNo}}. The deposit will be returned to the Lessee at the end of the agreement in accordance with its terms, less any amounts the Lessee owes.
receipt.depositInNoContract: We confirm that we have received from the Lessee a deposit of {{amount}} as security for the performance of his obligations towards the business. The deposit will be returned in accordance with the terms of the engagement, less any amounts the Lessee owes.
receipt.depositOut: We confirm that a deposit of {{amount}}, given under lease agreement No. {{contractNo}}, has been returned to the Lessee. By signing, the Lessee confirms receipt of the amount.
receipt.depositOutNoContract: We confirm that a deposit of {{amount}} has been returned to the Lessee. By signing, the Lessee confirms receipt of the amount.
receipt.payment: We confirm that we have received from {{name}} a payment of {{amount}}.
receipt.dealPaymentIn: We confirm that we have received from {{name}} a payment of {{amount}} on account of deal No. {{dealNo}}.
receipt.dealPaymentOut: We confirm that an amount of {{amount}} has been paid to {{name}} on account of deal No. {{dealNo}}. By signing, the recipient confirms receipt of the amount.

sale.consignmentNote: The Dealer sells the vehicle on consignment, on behalf of the registered owner of the vehicle: {{owner}}, ID / Company No. {{id}}. Ownership of the vehicle will pass to the Buyer directly from the registered owner.
sale.price: The price of the vehicle is {{price}}. The price includes VAT insofar as it applies to the transaction.
sale.paymentsIntro: Payments made up to the signing of this agreement:
sale.balanceTerms: The balance of the price shall be paid by the delivery of the vehicle, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Ownership of the vehicle will not be transferred to the Buyer before the full price is paid.
sale.depositCap: The price of the vehicle exceeds {{threshold}}; accordingly, no amount exceeding {{percent}}% of the price ({{max}}) will be collected from the Buyer before delivery of the vehicle except against a bank guarantee, in accordance with section 81 of the Vehicle Sector Services and Professions Licensing Law, 5776-2016.
sale.tradeIn: The Buyer delivers to the Dealer the vehicle described below, and its agreed value, {{value}}, is credited towards the price of the vehicle sold. The Buyer declares that he is the registered owner of the trade-in vehicle, that it is free of any lien, attachment or third-party right, and that he has given the Dealer all information known to him about its condition, including accidents and damage.
sale.delivery1: The vehicle will be delivered to the Buyer on {{date}} at the Dealer's place of business. From delivery, responsibility for the vehicle and the duty to insure it pass to the Buyer.
sale.delivery2: The Buyer confirms that he was given the opportunity to inspect the vehicle, including at a testing institute of his choice, and that he accepts the vehicle in the condition described in the disclosure form.
sale.disclosureSigned: Before signing this agreement the Buyer was given a separate disclosure form about the vehicle and signed it on {{date}}.
sale.disclosurePending: Before signing this agreement the Buyer will be given a separate disclosure form about the vehicle and will sign it.
sale.warrantyIntro: The warranty terms of the vehicle, as given to the Buyer in writing and in Hebrew in accordance with section 86 of the Vehicle Sector Services and Professions Licensing Law, 5776-2016:
sale.warrantyTranslation: The warranty terms are given in Hebrew as required by law; the Hebrew text above is the binding text.
sale.defaultWarranty: The vehicle is sold as is, as described in the disclosure form. The Dealer gives no warranty beyond that imposed on it by law.
sale.transfer1: The Dealer shall register the transfer of ownership of the vehicle to the Buyer at the licensing office within 6 working days of the sale, and no later than {{date}}, in accordance with section 93(b) of the law. The Buyer shall give the Dealer the documents required for this purpose.
sale.transfer2: Tickets, fines, fees and mandatory payments for the vehicle up to delivery are borne by the Dealer, and from then on by the Buyer.
sale.dealerSignature: The Dealer (name, dealer licence number, signature and stamp)

purchase.price: The Dealer purchases the vehicle from the Seller for {{price}}.
purchase.priceVat: The Dealer purchases the vehicle from the Seller for {{price}} plus VAT as required by law, against a tax invoice to be issued by the Seller.
purchase.paymentsIntro: Payments made to the Seller up to the signing of this agreement:
purchase.balanceTerms: The balance of the consideration will be paid to the Seller when the transfer of ownership to the Dealer is registered, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
purchase.tradeIn: The vehicle is delivered as part of a trade-in, and its agreed value is credited towards the purchase of another vehicle from the Dealer (deal No. {{dealNo}}).
purchase.decl1: The Seller is the registered and lawful owner of the vehicle and may sell it without the consent of any third party.
purchase.decl2: The vehicle is free of any lien, attachment, pledge, debt or other third-party right, and there is no impediment to registering the transfer of ownership.
purchase.decl3: The odometer reading at the time of sale is {{km}}, and to the best of the Seller's knowledge the odometer has not been altered or tampered with.
purchase.decl3Unknown: The odometer reading at the time of sale is __________ km, and to the best of the Seller's knowledge the odometer has not been altered or tampered with.
purchase.decl4: Accidents and damage known to the Seller, including repaired damage (if none, write "none"):
purchase.decl5: Previous use of the vehicle (tick as applicable):
purchase.decl6: All tickets, fines, fees and debts relating to the vehicle up to delivery are borne and will be paid by the Seller.
purchase.decl7: If information given by the Seller proves untrue or incomplete, the Dealer may cancel this agreement and claim its damages.
purchase.transfer1: The parties shall register the transfer of ownership of the vehicle to the Dealer immediately upon payment of the consideration.
purchase.transfer2: At delivery the Seller shall give the Dealer the vehicle, the vehicle licence, all keys and the vehicle documents in his possession. The Seller shall cancel his insurance policies for the vehicle after the transfer of ownership. Risk in the vehicle passes to the Dealer on delivery.
purchase.dealerSignature: The Buyer, the Dealer (name, dealer licence number, signature and stamp)

consignment.recital1: Whereas the Owner is the registered owner of the vehicle described below and wishes to sell it through the Dealer;
consignment.recital2: And whereas the Dealer is a licensed vehicle dealer and is willing to act to sell the vehicle on the terms set out below;
consignment.own1: Ownership of the vehicle remains with the Owner until its sale to a buyer is completed, and ownership will be transferred directly from the Owner to the buyer.
consignment.own2: The Owner shall keep the vehicle insured with compulsory and comprehensive or third-party insurance throughout the term of this agreement and shall show the Dealer the valid policies.
consignment.own3: On the sale of the vehicle the Dealer will give the buyer a disclosure form as required by law, stating that it sells the vehicle on consignment. The Owner undertakes to give the Dealer full and correct information about the vehicle, including the number of hands, previous use, known accidents and damage, and the odometer reading.
consignment.askingNone: The asking price will be set by agreement between the parties.
consignment.minNet: Minimum net amount the Owner will receive from the sale: {{amount}}. A sale yielding the Owner less than this amount requires the Owner's prior consent.

commission.FIXED: Dealer's commission: a fixed amount of {{value}}.
commission.PERCENT: Dealer's commission: {{value}}% of the actual sale price.
commission.SURPLUS: Dealer's commission: the entire amount above the Owner's minimum net amount.
commission.NONE: The Dealer's commission will be agreed in writing.

consignment.payout: Within 7 business days of receiving the full price from the buyer, the Dealer shall pay the Owner the sale price less the commission.
consignment.period: This agreement is in force from {{start}} until {{end}}.
consignment.periodOpen: This agreement is in force from {{start}} until terminated by written notice of either party.
consignment.period2: At the end of the agreement, if the vehicle has not been sold, it will be returned to the Owner in the condition in which it was delivered to the Dealer, save for reasonable wear and tear. The Owner may demand the return of the vehicle at any time on 3 business days' notice, provided that no sale agreement has yet been signed with a buyer.
consignment.liability1: The vehicle will be kept at the Dealer's place of business, and the Dealer is responsible for its reasonable safekeeping and for damage caused by the negligence of the Dealer or anyone on its behalf. The Dealer is not responsible for reasonable wear and tear, mechanical defects beyond its control or damage covered by the Owner's insurance.
consignment.liability2: Tickets and fines for trips made on behalf of the Dealer during the term of this agreement are borne by the Dealer; tickets for any other use of the vehicle are borne by the Owner.
consignment.testDrive: The Dealer may allow test drives by prospective buyers holding a valid driving licence, accompanied by a representative of the Dealer, for up to 20 km per drive, subject to suitable insurance cover (the Owner's insurance permitting any driver or the Dealer's trade insurance).
consignment.intakeKm: Mileage when delivered to the Dealer

disclosure.subtitle: Under section 4 of the Used Vehicle Sale Law, 5768-2008. This form is given to the buyer before the sale agreement is signed, as a separate document.
disclosure.dealerStatusConsignment: Seller's status: licensed vehicle dealer selling the vehicle on consignment. The vehicle is not registered in the dealer's name.
disclosure.ownerIsDealer: The vehicle is registered in the dealer's name (dealer-owned vehicle).
disclosure.damage: Details of all damage known to the dealer, including repaired damage (if none, write "none"):
disclosure.km: Odometer reading known to the dealer: {{km}}.
disclosure.kmUnknown: Odometer reading known to the dealer: __________ km.
disclosure.buyerDeclaration: I, the undersigned, confirm that I have read this form, that its details were given to me before signing the sale agreement, and that I have received a copy of it.
